items.label: [Night Stand with Charger Station]
items.value: 1 USB port, 2 outlets and 1 Type-C port are on the nightstand for bedrooms. Imagine plugging in your lamp, phone or watch before sleep, power is just within your reach, then be happy to greet the morning with fully charged devices. Plus: Contain patent pending drawer slide

items.label: [Fabric Drawer Install Up or Down]
items.value: 2 install positions of the drawer are available, you can install it for needed storage heights. 3 storage shelves and 1 fabric drawer on the bedside table are surely enough to store various items

items.label: [Storage Helper in Many Spaces]
items.value: Granted, it's a clutter-free side table with drawer for your books, cups..., but not only that, it can prop up your coffee, books beside the sofa or even as a storage rack in the living room or dorm. Plus: Adjustable feet will make it stable in any place

items.label: [Go for a Long Time]
items.value: Vintage wooden grain shelves blend black fabric and metal frame, making it a timeless classic. Sturdy P2 particle board, sturdy metal frame, and durable fabric drawer, all these work excellently to give this side table with charging station strong support

items.label: [Help to Assemble]
items.value: No complicated steps, with instruction, numbered components and tools, this tall end table will be finished quickly
